binary_signing_finding.status: DOCUMENTED, NOT A VECTOR TO ACCEPT
binary_signing_finding.finding: MetaMask Tron signMessage of raw bytes decodes them as UTF-8 lossily (invalid sequences become U+FFFD) and signs the re-encoded text, so distinct binary messages can share one signed text. Binary signing is never accepted on Tron (Ruling R15).
binary_signing_finding.recovers_under: TRON prefix, msg = UTF-8 of TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes), len = 238

wallet_transaction.description: MetaMask Tron on Nile refused every signTransaction at its simulation step (Confirm disabled), including node-built controls, so the run says nothing about locally built raw_data (Ruling R16). Task 6.3 owns the proof.
